postings.notes: Fixture row 1. 13 react-selects on the page, of which 9 are EEO/demographic and must stay untouched. Prior run evidence (applications/.../trace.jsonl): the `location` row — API field `location`, DOM id `candidate-location`, a Pelias autocomplete with no fixed option list — failed twice with `no_options_rendered` and ended as an `ask`; the `resume` upload failed once with `file_input_not_found`. Both are the regressions this bench must catch. `#country` is a separate react-select that drives the intl-tel-input `#phone`.

Carries a 24-option ValueSelect ("What brought you to this job posting") which per src/schema/ashby.mjs:21 should render as 24 radio inputs — whether Ashby switches to a dropdown at that length is unverified and is one of the things this row measures [INFERENCE]. Two one-option MultiValueSelects (a conditional-offer acknowledgement, required, and a marketing opt-in, optional) hit the same single-checkbox branch as row 7. Three required essays plus a `why_us`, so the writer path runs at full width. Two rows classified `sensitive` by label ("Pronouns", an accommodations textarea) must stay untouched. The two AI-topic essays are questions *about* AI tooling, not AI-usage attestations — the form carries no attestation and no login.
